messages:
Aisha Gomez: Morning all, I9m Aisha, starting today as Product Designer. Quick problem: Figma invite sent me to an endless SSO redirect. Anyone seen that?
Kai Thompson: Welcome Aisha! :tada: We saw that when people accept with non-work emails. Try incognito or use your @redwood.com address.
Aisha Gomez: I accepted with my personal account initially (oops). Incognito opened the file but then asked for org access.
Lina Morales: Hey Aisha :wave: I9ll reissue the invite to your work email. Also adding you to Product Notion and the research playbook. For SSO, if incognito works that's a good temporary workaround.
Aisha Gomez: Thanks Lina, I9ve got the new invite and now see "Product roadmap - Q2" and the UI kit. Do I need editor on the libraries?
Kai Thompson: For early exploration, editor on your personal project file and viewer on shared libraries is safest. We let new designers edit the exploration file.
Lina Morales: Done 52 I9ve granted Editor on "Aisha exploration" and Viewer on the shared libraries. Also shared the Research Sprint checklist link in Notion: Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints.
onboard-bot: :sparkles: Welcome Aisha! Onboarding checklist created. Please complete device setup, security training, and join #design-system.
Aisha Gomez: Great, thanks. One last thing: does Redwood have an interview guide template or consent language I should use?
Lina Morales: Yes 52 the Notion playbook includes the approved interview guide and consent language. Use the template and file a recruiting request if you need help scheduling. Happy to pair on your first interview plan.
Aisha Gomez: Perfect, will start duplicating the template and book time. Appreciate the quick help!
